title: Fix admin visibility: list all users and view their reports

requirements.text: Fix backend admin authorization so an allowlisted admin account can successfully access admin-only operations (including listing all users and accessing all reports) after signup/login.

quotes: still admin can not view all users. and their reports

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an allowlisted admin, calling the backend method that powers the Users admin page returns all stored user profiles (does not trap with an unauthorized/admin error).
When logged in as an allowlisted admin, calling the backend method that lists reports returns all stored reports across all users.
When logged in as a non-admin, admin-only backend operations (e.g., list users) remain denied with an authorization error.

requirements.text: Update the Admin Users UI to let admins view each user’s reports (per-user drilldown) using existing report data (reports include createdBy principal).

quotes: still admin can not view all users. and their reports

acceptanceCriteria: On the admin Users page, each listed user has a clear action (e.g., button/link) to view that user’s reports.
Clicking the action navigates to a reports view filtered to that selected user and shows only reports created by that user.
The filtered reports view is accessible only to admins (non-admins see the existing access denied UI).

requirements.text: Ensure the admin reports view supports showing all reports (unfiltered) and filtered-by-user reports with clear, English UI labels indicating the current filter.

quotes: still admin can not view all users. and their reports

acceptanceCriteria: Admins can switch between “All reports” and “Reports for <selected user>” (or equivalent) without needing a page reload.
The UI clearly indicates which user is selected when a user filter is active (e.g., shows the user’s name/username and/or principal).
If the selected user has no reports, the UI shows an English empty state message (e.g., “No reports found for this user.”).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding real-time updates (e.g., websockets) for admin dashboards.
Changing report data fields or introducing new report types beyond enabling admin visibility and per-user filtering.
